about_the_game:
ERADICATE THE DARKNESS THAT WRITHES BENEATH ALL OF TIME. 

Ninth Hell takes place in Ninthveil, a realm in ruin. The darkness has stained the ages, bleeding from the past into the present. You must follow it back through six ravaged eras, down to where it began: the ninth depth of Hell.

Track its origin into earlier and earlier ages, hunting its footprint to the moment it first entered Ninthveil. Each era is a different battlefield with its own terrors, its own fallen rulers, and the rot wearing a new face. With every victory the path narrows, the signs grow unmistakable, and the world seems to close around you, as though it is bracing for what waits below.

Fight as a Warrior, Sorceress, Rogue, or Necromancer. Each class commands three distinct masteries, each packed with deadly skills. Blend them freely and shape a playstyle that feels wholly your own.

And when at last you reach the ninth depth of Hell, you will not find a cure waiting to be claimed. You will find a will that chose this ruin and set it upon the world like a crown. Break that will, and the curse begins to unravel. The ages loosen their grip. The skies remember light. And Ninthveil, long silent, draws breath again.

180 TOTAL SKILLS TO WIELD AND MASTER

Each savior wields 45 abilities, every one with its own skill tree. Raise a horde of conjured minions, then shatter them in a blast of bone and shrapnel. Strike with your blade, only to vanish and let a storm of arrows finish what you started. Call down torrents of water, then split the sky with lightning, amplifying the devastation. Every skill feeds the next — every attack a masterpiece of destruction.

DISCOVER RARE LOOT FROM ACROSS THE AGES

In the depths of Ninth Hell, power is never without cost. Relic items, torn from the mangled bodies of fallen heroes, now rest in the claws of the monstrous fiends that bested them. Damned items, once wielded by the realm’s fiercest foes, offer unmatched strength - at a price. And runes, hidden throughout the lands, hold the power to transform your gear. Find the right combinations, and your gear will awaken as Runewords - artifacts of immense power that can completely redefine your build.

With each era, your arsenal deepens, filled with signature weapons and artifacts unique to their time. Collect, craft, and fuse their strengths to forge a style that’s entirely your own.

A HELLISH ENDGAME AWAITS

In the darkest corners of Ninth Hell, you may find Gateways of Perdition - each one a nightmarish gateway to a specific era and setting. Every gateway holds a unique boss, unique loot tables, and incentive to battle hordes of lesser fiends. These fiends drop fragments, which, when forged together, recreate the boss’s powerful gear.

But the true prize lies in the boss itself - defeat it, and you may claim its scale, a shimmering jewel that contains the creature's defining mechanic. Socket it into your equipment to wield its power, unlocking power even the steadiest of hands cannot control. Learn to control it and even more fun and build possibilities will be introduced!

PLAYER VERSUS PLAYER FUN

Test your skills against friends or strangers in Ninth Hell's PvP Act, filled with different arenas, each with their own era-specific charm, resulting in memorable battles.

WISHLIST AND FOLLOW NINTH HELL

As a solo developer, wishlisting and following helps immensely in getting Ninth Hell on the map! I appreciate you all!

content_descriptors.notes: Players will encounter violent and gory scenes while playing Ninth Hell. There is also some mild nudity depending on the monster humanoid and when you take off your armors.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2500 or AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 with 6GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 6500 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD RX 6600 with 6GB+ GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended.

short_description: A primordial darkness has infected the very fabric of existence, tainting past and present. You must hunt it down at its source. Battle through six ravaged eras, each steeped in its own horrors, and carve a path through history's ashes all the way down to the ninth depth of Hell.
